data.text:
Farmers from Batangas held a protest action at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila today, April 10. 

Kaisahan ng Manggagawang Bukid Secretary General Guillermo Hernandez said they are calling for aid for farmers amid the ongoing energy crisis. They are also pushing for the removal of Value-Added Tax (VAT) on petroleum products and for the government to repeal the Oil Deregulation Law.

Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste also attended the protest. He expressed support for his constituents’ call to reduce fuel taxes. | via Darlene Cay/GMA News

Visit https://t.co/bAMF9JOAN0 for more updates.

data.text:
From an employer standpoint, yes. Marami na tayong holiday sa Pilipinas.

With that said, however, our holidays are also ways for the working force to actually enjoy their salaries (if they can) and recharge from regular working days where they are dehuminized through our commute and traffic system.

Sure, one can argue viability economically, but one must also look at the positive aspects it brings to the working force’s health especially since the Philippines are reporting an epidemic in mental health issues right now.

Further, holidays can also be seen as echoes of the policies laid in our Constitution—the importance of family and the respect for religions.

I think the question should not be, “hindi ba masyado na tayong maraming holidays kahit marami sa working force ang hindi nakaka-enjoy nito?”. Rather, the question should be “How do we ensure that all people in the workforce get to enjoy this?”.

Inclusion over removal due to systemic exclusion :)

NEWS UPDATE: Narekober na ng mga awtoridad ang bangkay ng piloto at kaniyang asawa na sakay ng bumagsak na Cessna plane sa Dinagat Islands.

Kinilala ang piloto na si Jose Ortoll, na pinaniniwalaang lumipad mula Subic patungong Siargao.

Ayon sa mga awtoridad, bumagsak ang eroplano sa kabundukan nang walang naitalang distress call, halos 15 minuto bago ang inaasahang paglapag nito sa Siargao Airport noong Miyerkules.

Nagsimula na ang imbestigasyon ng Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines upang matukoy ang sanhi ng aksidente.
